text.en: Don't — please. I only kept the books. Durn holds the dais, his men hold the corridor, and I counted what came in through the breach.
text.id: Jangan — kumohon. Aku hanya penjaga buku. Durn memegang anjungan, anak buahnya memegang koridor, dan aku menghitung apa yang masuk lewat celah itu.

text.en: The manifest? Red chest, right here in the vault. Everything Harrow's steward sent, signed and stamped. Take it — when the Castellan is in no state to take it back.
text.id: Manifest itu? Peti merah, di ruang bawah ini. Semua kiriman pengurus Harrow, bertanda dan bersegel. Ambillah — saat sang Castellan sudah tak bisa merebutnya kembali.
